variables.physical_definition: Vertical distance between the bottom and top surfaces of the fluid layer (height of the container).
Temperature difference between the bottom and top surfaces.
Thermal conductivity of the fluid relating heat flux to temperature gradient.
Acceleration due to gravity providing the buoyancy force.
Thermal (volumetric) expansion coefficient: fractional change in density per unit increase in temperature at constant pressure.
Kinematic viscosity of the fluid (momentum diffusivity).
Thermal diffusivity of the fluid (thermal energy diffusivity).
